en-US.description: An open-source, clean-room spreadsheet reimplementation of Microsoft Excel, rebuilt in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
GridCraft is a fast, open-source, clean-room reimplementation of the Microsoft Excel workflow, rebuilt in pure Rust. One Rust codebase runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and BSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly, with no subscription, no licence server and no telemetry.

- Familiar: Excel's ribbon, formula bar, Name Box, sheet tabs, keyboard shortcuts, fill handle, point-mode formula entry with coloured references, Format Cells, Paste Special, conditional formatting, tables, charts and more.
- Compatible: XLSX is the native format; styles, themes, formulas including dynamic arrays, tables, conditional formats, validation, comments, hyperlinks, charts, pictures, sparklines, PivotTables and print settings round-trip. CSV and TSV too.
- Capable: a dependency-graph calculation engine with dynamic arrays and spilling, 500+ worksheet functions plus LET, LAMBDA, MAP, REDUCE, SCAN, BYROW, BYCOL and MAKEARRAY, structured table references, Excel's full number-format language, sort and AutoFilter, Flash Fill, data validation, outlining and subtotals.
- Charts and PivotTables: seventeen chart types with a Chart Design tab and Format pane, and PivotTables with field list, filters, layouts, date grouping and show-values-as, saved to and read from XLSX.
- Fast: copy-on-write workbooks where undo snapshots are nearly free, incremental recalculation, and a virtualised grid that only lays out what is on screen.
- Agent-native: every ribbon button, menu item, dialog, keystroke and mouse gesture is a command that agents can run over a JSON control channel, an MCP server or the CLI.

zh-CN.description: 一个用纯 Rust 全新重写的开源净室实现，还原了 Microsoft Excel 的工作流
zh-CN.longDescription:
GridCraft 是一个用纯 Rust 全新重写的开源净室实现，还原了 Microsoft Excel 的工作流。同一份 Rust 代码可在 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 BSD 上原生运行，也可通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行，没有订阅、没有许可服务器、没有遥测。

- 熟悉：Excel 的功能区、编辑栏、名称框、工作表标签、键盘快捷键、填充柄、带彩色引用的指针模式公式输入、设置单元格格式、选择性粘贴、条件格式、表格和图表等。
- 兼容：XLSX 是原生格式；样式、主题、公式（含动态数组）、表格、条件格式、数据验证、批注、超链接、图表、图片、迷你图、数据透视表和打印设置都能完整往返。CSV 和 TSV 亦然。
- 强大：带动态数组与溢出的依赖图计算引擎，500 多个工作表函数，外加 LET、LAMBDA、MAP、REDUCE、SCAN、BYROW、BYCOL 和 MAKEARRAY，结构化表格引用，Excel 完整的数字格式语言，排序和自动筛选，闪电填充，数据验证，分级显示和分类汇总。
- 图表与数据透视表：十七种图表类型，图表设计选项卡和格式窗格；数据透视表支持字段列表、筛选、布局、日期分组和值显示方式，可保存到 XLSX 并从中读取。
- 快速：写时复制工作簿（撤销快照几乎零成本）、增量重算，以及只布局屏幕内容的虚拟化网格。
- 代理友好：功能区按钮、菜单项、对话框、按键和鼠标手势都是命令，代理可通过 JSON 控制通道、MCP 服务器或 CLI 调用。
